main.title: Russian missile hits Poland as Ukraine's allies hold military exercise, says Tusk
main.summary: Nobody was hurt and no damage has been reported, but Warsaw described the incident as a "provocation" from Moscow.

related.title: Ukraine updates: Russian attack 'one of largest,' Zelenskyy says
related.summary: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy said Russia launched one of the largest aerial attacks since the invasion began. Poland accused Moscow of a "provocation," saying two missiles landed in the NATO country. Follow DW.

related.title: Europe Tonight: EU and UK strike post-Brexit reset deal as Russian missiles hit Poland
related.summary: The EU and UK have struck a major post-Brexit reset deal in Brussels. In tonight’s edition of Europe Tonight, we bring you a live interview from the summit, assess security alarms after Russian missiles hit Poland, and examine the final-day standoff at COP31.

210139a1ca.topic: Missili russi cadono in Polonia, NATO in allerta
210139a1ca.reason: Due missili russi sono caduti sul territorio di un Paese NATO durante uno dei più grandi attacchi su Kiev e Leopoli. Varsavia parla di "provocazione": è una questione di sicurezza europea che riguarda anche l'Italia, e ne scrivono più testate autorevoli.
